# Qabas Alkaissi

> Computer engineer from Amman, Jordan. B.Sc. in Computer Engineering from Princess Sumaya University for Technology (PSUT), 2021–2026, ranked first in the department and the School of Engineering (GPA 95.1/100). Research on adversarial robustness for computer vision, hardware security with physical unclonable functions (PUFs), and graph algorithms. Open to research collaborations and graduate study.

Contact: qabaskaissi@gmail.com · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/qabas-alkaissi) · [GitHub](https://github.com/QabasAK) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=SdNXE7MAAAAJ) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0009-9129-5249)

## Key facts

- Research Intern, KAUST CyberSaR Group (Oct–Dec 2025, Visiting Student Research Program), supervised by Prof. Ali Shoker
- Undergraduate Research Assistant, PSUT (since Mar 2024)
- System Architect and IT Lead, Lumari LLC (since Oct 2026)
- National Academic Excellence Award, Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, Jordan (2026)
- Third place nationally, Jordanian Semiconductor Design Competition (2025)
